title: STILL HERE P: PROPULSION (CONTROL120)
description: CONTROL: P V2 at a fixed 120 BPM (four bars after ignition instead of five), same idea, arrangement and palette.

tracks.description: The factory heartbeat: the kick asleep inside the MORPH press clank on the A pedal at 0, 1 and 2 s; at 3 s the press alone as the turbine takes over; the lock at the end.
Electronic kick (swept sine, click, drive), four on the floor from ignition.
Clap layered on an electronic snare on 2 and 4; a 16th roll in the climb.
808-style metallic hats in 16ths, open on the off-beat eighths from bar 4.
MORPH//04 cable ticks: the 3+3+2 precision rhythm, the turbine ratchet, quiet accents after ignition.
Electronic crash (metallic squares and noise, different per side).
Analog-style bass one-shots (saw + square + sine, 24 dB low-pass), gated natively; the call 1-5-8 in tresillo; ducked under the kick.
Resonant square/saw pluck-lead with a pitch blip: the call D5-A5-D6 above the chord, the answer 3-5-6, the 6->8 completion.
The intro robot answer: a triangle blip C#5-E5-F#5.
Saw stabs: with the call (3+3+2) in the hook bars, on the chord changes (G, Bb, C), the tutti ending and the final D.
Warm polysynth pad under the groove (Dadd9, Gadd9, Bb, C, D), ducked by the kick.
Pulse/saw pluck arpeggio in 16ths with 3+3+2 accents, from the IV bar, dotted-eighth echo.
EXTERNAL: MORPH//03 Tempo String: A's dormant statements under the bass (0-2.8 s) and the turbine wound into A1 (3.0-3.875 s).
EXTERNAL: MORPH FDN room of lead, pad, arpeggio and blips, re-created at their exact frames.
